description: We the students of Grade 5 created an interactive SPHEREx space exploration website using NASA resources. Our project helps young learners discover galaxies, stars, and the mysteries of the Universe through engaging visuals and educational content, inspiring curiosity about space science and the search for the origins of our Universe.
summary:
Project Summary
SPHEREx Sky Explorer is an interactive web-based platform inspired by NASA's SPHEREx mission.
It introduces users to infrared astronomy, galaxy evolution, cosmic origins, and life-essential molecules  
through an engaging digital experience, making complex astronomical concepts easier to understand.

Technology Stack
1.Canva Website Builder – Website design and development.
2.HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript – Web technologies (if applicable).
3.Canva Hosting – Website publishing.


AI Tools Used
1.ChatGPT – Content creation and brainstorming.
2.Google Gemini – Research assistance.
3.Canva Magic Studio – AI-assisted design.
4.Grammarly – Writing improvement.


NASA Resources
1. https://www.jpl.nasa.gov/missions/spherex/

details:
Project Overview

SPHEREx Sky Explorer is an educational space-exploration project inspired by NASA's SPHEREx space telescope. It introduces users to the wonders of the universe, galaxies, stars and infrared astronomy.

The project aims to make space science easier and more interesting to understand through an interactive digital experience.
